<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BringCar" name="Bring car to service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceVisit" name="Service visit registered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair done"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_App" name="Police Reminder App" processRef="Process_App"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car Owner" processRef="Process_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed" sourceRef="EndEvent_Facility_Completed" targetRef="StartEvent_App_ServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="SendTask_App_NotifyOwner" targetRef="StartEvent_Owner_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BringCar" name="Bring car to service" sourceRef="SendTask_Owner_BringCar" targetRef="StartEvent_Facility_CarArrives"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceVisit" name="Service visit registered" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_Facility_ServiceVisit" targetRef="CatchEvent_App_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Status1" name="Status update" sourceRef="SendTask_Facility_Status1" targetRef="CatchEvent_Owner_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Status2" name="Repair completed status update" sourceRef="SendTask_Facility_Status2" targetRef="CatchEvent_Owner_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDone" name="Repair done" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_Facility_RepairDone" targetRef="CatchEvent_App_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="SendTask_Owner_Pay" targetRef="CatchEvent_App_Payment"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Police reminder app -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_App" name="Police Reminder App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_App_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_App_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_App_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_App_Registered" name="Car still registered?" default="Flow_App_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_App_NotRegistered" name="Reminder not sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_App_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of due service"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_App_ServiceWait" name="Service visit or 30 days?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_App_ServiceVisit" name="Service visit registered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_App_ServiceVisit" messageRef="Msg_ServiceVisit"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_App_Timer30" name="30 days elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_App_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_App_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_App_Fined" name="Fine issued"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_App_RepairDone" name="Repair done">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_App_RepairDone" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_App_Payment" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_App_Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_App_Paid" name="Repair paid"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_App_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="ServiceTask_App_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_2" sourceRef="ServiceTask_App_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_App_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_Registered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_App_Registered" targetRef="SendTask_App_NotifyOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_App_Registered" targetRef="EndEvent_App_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" sourceRef="SendTask_App_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_App_ServiceWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" sourceRef="Gateway_App_ServiceWait" targetRef="CatchEvent_App_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="Gateway_App_ServiceWait" targetRef="CatchEvent_App_Timer30"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="CatchEvent_App_Timer30" targetRef="ServiceTask_App_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" sourceRef="ServiceTask_App_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_App_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_8" sourceRef="CatchEvent_App_ServiceVisit" targetRef="CatchEvent_App_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_9" sourceRef="CatchEvent_App_RepairDone" targetRef="CatchEvent_App_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_10" sourceRef="CatchEvent_App_Payment" targetRef="EndEvent_App_Paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_NotRegistered_Default" sourceRef="Gateway_App_Registered" targetRef="EndEvent_App_NotRegistered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Car owner -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Owner" name="Car Owner" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Owner_Reminder" name="Service reminder received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Owner_Reminder" messageRef="Msg_ServiceReminder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Owner_BringCar" name="Bring car to service"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Owner_Merge" name="Waiting for repair"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Owner_StatusUpdate" name="Receive status update by email">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Owner_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Owner_RepairDone" name="Repair done?" default="Flow_Owner_NotDone"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Owner_Pay" name="Pay repair via app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Owner_Paid" name="Repair paid"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Owner_Reminder" targetRef="SendTask_Owner_BringCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_2" sourceRef="SendTask_Owner_BringCar" targetRef="Gateway_Owner_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Owner_Merge" targetRef="CatchEvent_Owner_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_4" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Owner_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_Owner_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_Done" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Owner_RepairDone" targetRef="SendTask_Owner_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_NotDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Owner_RepairDone" targetRef="Gateway_Owner_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_5" sourceRef="SendTask_Owner_Pay" targetRef="EndEvent_Owner_Paid"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Car service facility -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Facility_CarArrives" name="Car arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Facility_CarArrives" messageRef="Msg_BringCar"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_Facility_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="ThrowEvent_Facility_ServiceVisit" name="Service visit registered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Facility_ServiceVisit" messageRef="Msg_ServiceVisit"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Facility_Status1" name="Send status update by email"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_Facility_Repair" name="Perform repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_Facility_EnterRepairSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and "Pickerl""/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="ThrowEvent_Facility_RepairDone" name="Repair done">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Facility_RepairDone" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Facility_Status2" name="Send repair completed status update"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_Facility_EnterNextService" name="Enter time of next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Facility_Completed" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Facility_Completed" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Facility_CarArrives" targetRef="UserTask_Facility_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="UserTask_Facility_EnterProblems" targetRef="ThrowEvent_Facility_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_Facility_ServiceVisit" targetRef="SendTask_Facility_Status1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="SendTask_Facility_Status1" targetRef="ManualTask_Facility_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="ManualTask_Facility_Repair" targetRef="UserTask_Facility_EnterRepairSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="UserTask_Facility_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="ThrowEvent_Facility_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_Facility_RepairDone" targetRef="SendTask_Facility_Status2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_8" sourceRef="SendTask_Facility_Status2" targetRef="UserTask_Facility_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_9" sourceRef="UserTask_Facility_EnterNextService" targetRef="EndEvent_Facility_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
